root_cause.text: Bluetooth socket destructors did not purge the `sk_error_queue`, allowing SKBs queued by TX timestamping (SO_TIMESTAMPING) to leak when the socket is closed without those entries being consumed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `skb_queue_purge(&sk->sk_error_queue)` to the destructors of four Bluetooth socket types (hci_sock, iso, l2cap_sock, sco), and the CVE description states that SKBs in `sk_error_queue` from TX timestamping will leak if userspace never reads them or if the controller is removed.
